why: #34063: cmux cloud start-session --login pass|machine|none. The login policy is Rust's (cmux-cloud-start-core harness_login) and the ask and per-user store live in CmuxNextCloudCredentials (CloudHarnessLoginAsk, CloudHarnessLoginChoices); the App keeps only the forwarding over App-only types: reading --login with who asked (ActionRunScope, CloudHandlers), the refusal texts in the App's CloudSessions table, the run key and retry command fields of CloudStartSession.Request, and the Codex broker and machine sign-in checks that need CloudService and the machine API.
